1. **#2824**, "(feat) O3-6098: Show today's appointments and visit attribute tags in the current visit summary", merged **2026-10-14**. Commit `a7bd67168e3db4b095f8a1c06451549d3ec77b79`. It rewrote the `visitCustomRepresentation` string in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/constants.ts`. 2. **#2600**, "(feat) O3-5763: Unify the Current visit and Previous visit views", merged **2026-08-28**. Commit `7212897e35ee9efa79192770f019651dcbd66cc1`. It added `visitCustomRepresentation` to `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/constants.ts`, including the `encounterProviders:(uuid,display,encounterRole:(uuid,display),provider:(uuid,person:(uuid,display)))` field.

Merge dates are the squash-commit dates on main (the commit subjects carry the PR numbers). Converted to UTC, #2600 is 2026-08-28 10:42 and #2824 is 2026-10-14 13:55.

- At HEAD, `encounterProviders` appears in `constants.ts` line 24 (the current `visitCustomRepresentation`) and in `service-queues.resource.ts` lines 53 and 70. Those two resource lines were not changed in the window.
- Before 2026-04-16 the term did not appear anywhere in the app.
- Other commits in the window that touched `service-queues.resource.ts` or `constants.ts` (#2322, #2520, #2710, #2540, and the #2511 linelist change) add or remove no `encounterProviders` line.
